'''Curata''', officially the '''Republic of Curata''', is a country in northwestern [[Central Atirha]], bordered by [[Raledria]] on the north, [[Fincen]] to the east, and the [[Northern Eanif Ocean]] on the south. The country's capital and largest city is [[Hulong]]. The territory was first colonised by the [[Emaran Empire]] during early 15th century, achieving independence in 1540 as part of [[Raledria]], from which it emerged as a sovereign state in 1612 after the [[Great Atirhan War]]. Curata became independent in 1615 and has since been a republic, although it has consistently endured much social strife and political instability. In the 1680s, the nation went through a [[Curatan Civil war|civil war]] where the current constitution was established in 1680. 

The legacy of both empires is reflected in Curata's ethnically diverse population, with most of its 2.5 million people being [[Emara|Emaran]], followed by large minorities of [[Ayuma|Ayuman]], [[Massir|Massiran]], [[Mahea|Mahean]], and [[Quia|Quian]] descendants. [[Emaran language|Emaran]] is the official language spoken by a majority of the population, although [[13 immigrant languages]] are also recognised.

Curata is a representative [[wikipedia:Presidential_system|democratic presidential republic]] and a developing country whose economy is highly dependent on exports of commodities, primarily [[wikipedia:Mining|mineral]] and [[wikipedia:Agriculture|agricultural]] products. According to the Centre for Economic and Policy Research, between 1755 and 1762, poverty decreased from 16.7% to 6.5%, and [[annual per capita GDP growth was 4.5]] percent (as compared to 0.6 percent over the prior two decades). At the same time, the country's [[Gini index of economic]] inequality improved from 0.55 to 0.47.

In the 1760s, Curata plays a central role in [[wikipedia:Illegal_drug_trade|international drug trafficking]]. Nearly 80% of the drugs imported to [[Raledria]] are moved through Curatan territory.
